name: notes
description: A git-backed markdown notebook. Notes are plain `.md` files in a git repository on your machine, so every version is recoverable, the whole notebook is portable, and it stays readable in any editor without PersonalClaw. Drafting and history live here; indexed recall stays with Knowledge — this app builds no index of its own.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Notebook folder
x-meta.help: Where your notes live. Empty keeps them in this app's own data dir, which survives uninstall and reinstall. Point it at a folder inside an existing git repo and the notebook adopts that repo instead of nesting a new one.
